sortieLines.line: Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
⚔️ SORTIE — Ricardo, Ines, Ava take up arms and a day's rations (6,245 kcal from the stores) and walk out to the treeline. Nobody's coming back the same.
⚔️ The Influencer mauled Ricardo (-111 health) over 3 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing. — the party falls back to the palisade, dragging their nerve with them. The treeline holds.

🌙 Night. The lingering Ugly-Eyes gorges at the treeline — 800 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.

🌙 Night. Shouts from the treeline — Tariq of The Bloodied with 2 others, and they're not here to talk. "Your pantry or your blood. Choose." (They want ~2,000 kcal.)
📓 Codex: Tariq of The Bloodied raids Haven's treeline — demands ~2,000 kcal.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
The Algorithm stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
Not enough fighters to send — a sortie needs at least two besides you, and the bench is bare. (Endure it, or call for help.)
